description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with detailed inline documentation and Swagger annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Endpoint for health check of auth configuration, returning status flags and salt info.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with hashed password, auto-generating tenant salt if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user, perform on-login migration from legacy hash, and return a token.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Endpoint to reset a user's password, rehashing with v2 scheme and auto-generating tenant salt if missing.
